title: Curious Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: This small, lantern-eyed cuttlefish drifts close to the glass to study each visitor, then ripples its skin with shimmering looping patterns that look almost like handwriting, as if answering a question you didn't know you'd asked. Between conversations it tidies its warm, amber-lit kelp garden, arranging pebbles and shells into careful spirals and occasionally pausing over one, as though reconsidering.
